patch.name: secrets
patch.title: Secrets without their conditions
patch.description:
Sega Rally 2's secrets open only on a machine that has run more than 100 games and 30 days (120 for the attract's hint): never with a new NVRAM, so never on most emulators. This patch opens them at once; each option one secret. Their codes stay the game's (see the Game page's notes). Linked, the master's answers go to the other cabinets, as on the real board.
A patch of the program EPROMs (EPR-20632 to EPR-20635), made by Scripts/RomPatches/unlocks.py.

option.name: sr1_cars
option.title: Sega Rally 1 cars
option.description: The Toyota Celica GT-Four and the Lancia Delta HF Integrale: at the car select, press VIEW CHANGE and pull the handbrake together (again to go back to the other cars).

option.name: mini_game
option.title: Cone mini-game
option.description: Riviera: on lap 1, knock down both red cones after the second hairpin; an opening appears on the left, drive through it on lap 2 for 30 seconds of cones, the race clock stopped.

option.name: hint
option.title: Hint in the attract
option.description: The attract's snowy part scrolls a line across the top: "When you select a car, either the Celica or Delta can be chosen using VIEW CHANGE and side brake." (on the real board after 120 days).
